lowres_ok: Nintendo's Switch 2 store trailer for Stellar Blade Complete Edition (US nsuid 70010000123388, 1280x720, the only video on the store page); Nintendo's YouTube channel is not reachable here and no 1080p press-kit file is public
note: Sources: Nintendo Life review (7/10, 'Perfectly Playable, Despite Drawbacks', 2 Nov 22:00Z; pros combat and exploration, cons forgettable story, visuals and performance good but not great), Polygon review headline ('Best Action Game Is (Mostly) Just as Good in Stunning Switch 2 Port', 2 Nov 22:00Z; body not read). Footage: Nintendo store trailer, face, flight and boss shots chosen clear of the body-focused and gore shots. Release 5 Nov per Nintendo Life listing; price left out. v2: third line softened to 'بجودة الأصل غالبًا' (Polygon: mostly just as good), per the grammar review. v3: shot 2 starts at 62.6 s (61.3 opened on a black frame).
